description: This Java class 'AuthenticationServerClient' provides methods to interact with a remote authentication server via AMQP 1.0 protocol. It includes functionality for verifying user credentials using SASL mechanisms, handling connection setup, message processing, and token retrieval.

classes.name: AuthenticationServerClient
classes.description: A final class that provides client functionalities for authenticating users via an authentication server using AMQP 1.0, implementing credential verification and token retrieval.

methods.name: AuthenticationServerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with Vertx instance and ConnectionFactory, ensuring non-null parameters.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Attempts to verify user identity using SASL EXTERNAL mechanism; currently implemented as unsupported, always returning a failed future.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Performs username/password authentication against the remote server using SASL PLAIN, establishes a connection, retrieves token, handles success or failure.

methods.name: mapConnectionFailureToServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Maps various connection or authentication errors to specific ServiceInvocationException subclasses.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Handles message reception from the server, extracting the JWT token from the AMQP message payload, or failing upon error conditions.

methods.name: openReceiver
methods.description: Sets up a ProtonReceiver link on the provided connection to receive messages from the authentication server, with configured message handler.
